gaps.title: Target repository has no non-empty exact-head native Actions evidence
gaps.external_dependency: GitHub organization/repository Actions enablement, billing/runner and allowed-actions policy
close_criteria: a workflow run exists for the exact current pull-request head
the required aggregate job is non-empty, terminal and successful
run, job and artifact identities are recorded in evidence
a skipped, cancelled, absent or older-head collection is rejected

gaps.title: main is unprotected and required checks/reviews are not enforced
gaps.external_dependency: GitHub ruleset or branch-protection write access
close_criteria: direct pushes to main are blocked
trillionnium-game-merge-gate is required
latest-head approval invalidation is enabled
at least one independent review is required
the repository API is read back and confirms the active policy

gaps.title: Open integration PR describes a stale candidate identity
close_criteria: the stale PR is updated to its exact head or closed as superseded
there is exactly one active integration line for the same scope
the replacement PR body records exact head/tree and limitations

gaps.title: The plan checker freezes every task and gate in its initial state
close_criteria: scope validation is separated from execution-state validation
legal task state transitions are machine checked
gate status is derived from evidence and dependencies
real progress no longer causes the plan contract to fail

gaps.title: Evidence files are not unified behind a validated index
close_criteria: every evidence item is indexed exactly once
target commit/tree and artifact digest are present
review and expiry policy are validated
relay evidence is rejected when target identity does not match

gaps.title: Two incompatible schema families can be mistaken for production authority
close_criteria: migrations/ is declared and checked as the only production DDL authority
database/schema/v2 is marked non-authoritative and not consumed by runtime, CI, backup or release tooling
adapter SQL ABI and backup evidence bind the same migration digest
PostgreSQL and CockroachDB catalog evidence are separate

gaps.title: No end-to-end first-party Rust server binary exists
close_criteria: a Rust binary boots from typed config
migrate, health, readiness and graceful shutdown execute
one HTTP/gRPC and one WebSocket path reach an authority transition
the transition commits through the authoritative schema and creates a transactional outbox intent
retry, restart and exact oracle differential evidence pass

gaps.title: Security-critical JWT adapter uses private crypto primitives outside the unified workspace gate
close_criteria: the adapter is always compiled, tested and linted by the aggregate merge gate
constant-time comparison and malformed-token corpus pass
crypto implementation choice is recorded in an ADR
an independent security reviewer accepts the adapter or a reviewed library replacement

gaps.title: constant_time_eq truncates the length difference to eight bits
close_criteria: different lengths are rejected without integer truncation
regression vectors include a 256-byte length delta
JWT signature verification still requires exactly 32 bytes

gaps.title: Outbox retry mutates attempt before returning the terminal limit error
close_criteria: retry at the limit performs a defined atomic terminal transition
no leased record remains stranded by an error return
property/regression tests cover max-attempt and stale-owner behavior

gaps.title: The runtime Go module still uses the pre-rename repository path
close_criteria: all active module/document references use TrillionniumGame
historical previous-name references are explicitly labelled as historical
Go tests and module resolution pass

gaps.title: Live database tests can silently return success when their environment is absent
close_criteria: required CI lanes set an explicit live-test-required flag
the test process fails when a required database URL/profile is absent
developer opt-out remains explicit and cannot produce remote verification credit

gaps.title: Storage public version semantics are not yet Nakama-exact
close_criteria: public ContentVersion exactly matches the pinned Nakama behavior
internal IntegrityDigest is a separate type
empty, star and exact expected-version behavior pass differential tests
batch atomicity and ACL effects match the oracle

gaps.title: PG-wire adapter lacks production pool, TLS, deadline and bounded retry integration
close_criteria: connection pooling and acquire timeout are bounded
TLS and certificate rotation profiles exist
serializable retry obeys total request deadline and jitter budget
cancellation, statement timeout and metrics are wired
Cockroach transaction restart behavior is separately proven

gaps.title: D0-D8 final leaves remain unclassified and unlocked
gaps.external_dependency: exact-source workflow execution and independent classification review
close_criteria: all fourteen denominator manifests are non-empty and locked
every leaf has owner, task, test, profile and evidence mapping
unclassified_count is zero
manifest digests are reproduced from the pinned source

gaps.title: Development, architecture and audit indexes expose only old narrow slices
close_criteria: indexes link the current plan, state, gaps, architecture, testing, security and evidence controls
historical tranche documents remain discoverable but are not presented as current authority

gaps.title: Many duplicated historical feature refs remain unclassified
close_criteria: every non-main ref is classified keep/archive/delete
active PR heads are retained
deletion is executed only after immutable ref evidence
post-operation branch inventory matches the approved manifest

gaps.title: Database, security, protocol and realtime evidence lacks enforced independent reviewers
gaps.external_dependency: named reviewer availability and repository review policy
close_criteria: review roles resolve to named GitHub users or teams
self-approval is rejected
required evidence contains accepted independent review decisions
review expiry and head-change invalidation are enforced
